destination.title: What the Table Was Actually About

era_note: United States, 1972-1978. Anaheim and Winamac; the Grush-Saunby filing of September 1973.

shorts.angle: Two engineers wrote an eight-page report with a table that counted deaths and priced them. Four years later a magazine reprinted it, and almost nobody noticed what the table was about.
shorts.avoids: No claim about the number of burn deaths; no claim the table set a price on a Pinto life; no assertion that it was an internal memo; no dollar figure in this Short.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: The document has a title nobody reads out. What does it say it is?
shorts.loop_join: The last line returns to the table the first line put on page six.
